title: Ghost-slot prefill and speculative coalescing for reducing KV fragmentation stalls
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: Paged attention workloads suffer tail-latency spikes when small fragmented KV slots cause prefill to stall while waiting for contiguous allocation or heavyweight compaction. Existing strategies (aggressive eviction or large background compaction) either regress reuse or increase jitter on decode paths.

Proposal: Implement a lightweight 'ghost-slot' layer: ephemeral prefill descriptors that reserve logical residue for an incoming token span without moving/merging fragments immediately. Combine this with a speculative coalescing pass that opportunistically merges adjacent fragments during low-util windows and a hotmap-based prefill admission policy to prioritize slots likely to be read in the near future. Integrate kernel-selection hints so the runtime can prefer single-shot decode kernels when ghost-slot occupancy is high, and fallback to incremental decode with background coalescer when occupancy is low.

Goals:
- Reduce prefill-induced stalls on p99/p995 tails by 20-40% for 8k+ context workloads.
- Preserve reuse: avoid regressing token-level reuse rate by more than 3%.
- Keep steady-state CPU overhead < 6% on serving nodes.

Design notes:
- Ghost-slot is a metadata-only reservation: no immediate memory copy; it records token span, expected size, lease expiry, and reuse score.
- Prefill admission uses a decay-weighted hotmap per-tenant aggregated over recent RPCs to estimate reuse probability. Only spans above threshold get ghost-slot fastpath.
- Speculative coalescer: incremental in-place merge of adjacent fragments when contiguous GPU pages are available; uses a low-priority background thread on each node; can be rate-limited by GPU memory stall events.
- Kernel hinting: runtime exposes a hint flag (GHOST_HIGH_CONFIDENCE) to the kernel selector to prefer combined-kernel execution (larger kernels that assume contiguous KV) when applicable. Kernel selection falls back if merges fail.

Trade-offs and risk mitigation:
- Risk: ghost-slot mispredictions could increase memory pressure if many reservations occupy space for long-lived leases. Mitigation: short lease defaults (50-200ms), aggressive decay, and automatic demotion to 'soft' reservations that don't block eviction.
- Risk: background coalescer could contend with decode. Mitigation: coalescer yields on detected decode latency regressions and uses a token/slice budget to bound GPU time.

Acceptance criteria:
- Microbench harness shows p99 prefill CPU wait reduced >= 20% with similar reuse ratio.
- End-to-end serving benchmark (mixed-tenant) shows p99 latency improvement and <3% increase in cost-per-token metric.
- No customer-facing regressions observed in a 48h canary on a dedicated pool with synthetic replay.

Next steps and TODOs:
1) Spike: implement ghost-slot metadata and hotmap sketch (Diego, 1.5w).
2) Perf harness: replay 8k+ contexts and collect p50/p95/p99/p995 for prefill and decode (SLO team + Eng, 1w).
3) Speculative coalescer prototype and backpressure hooks (Diego + Rafael, 2w).
4) Kernel hint plumbing and small-kernel fallback integration (Runtime team, 1w).
5) Canary deploy to dedicated cluster and monitor metrics/dashboards (Ops + Eng, 1w).

2026-02-26: Design review - questions from Kernel team about safe kernel hint ABI. Kernel team requests a fallback path and a per-request flag so A/B tests can toggle behavior. Action: add GHOST_CONFIDENCE flag in request metadata (Diego).
2026-03-02: Perf run on perf-cluster-3 with 8k contexts: p99 prefill latency down 22%, p995 down 18%. Reuse rate unchanged within 1.5%. CPU utilization +3.8%. Attaching raw traces in attachments.
2026-03-05: Code review feedback from Sofia (Runtime): ensure ghost-slot lease expiration runs on fast path to avoid build-up under heavy load. Added lease-eviction sampler patch (PR linked).
2026-03-08: Integration note - background coalescer blocked by OOM when multiple tenants aggressive coalesce. Implemented tenant-level coalescing quotas and demotion to soft reservations.

2026-03-10: Preparing canary plan. Need ops runbook entries for aborting coalescer and toggling kernel hints. Asked SRE to prepare dashboards for ghost-slot occupancy, leases-churn, coalescer GPU-time.
